facts.text: Mr Brown, I made you marmalade on toast. Aunt Lucy says a good breakfast makes everything easier.
facts.why: Not a line Paddington says. The real written line is his luggage label, 'Please look after this bear. Thank you.' (both the IMDb synopsis and the Paddington 2 wiki page quote it). Who wrote the label is not stated in the sources opened, so the fix is credited to Aunt Lucy as the likeliest, which should be checked.
facts.fix: Please look after this bear. Thank you.

facts.why: Mr Gruber is the antique shop owner, but none of the pages opened show him serving cake or elevenses. Dundee cake is a menu invention, not a scene.

facts.text: Mr Gruber's orange cocoa with cream
facts.why: I recall Mr Gruber offering cocoa in his shop, but none of the pages opened mention it, and the orange and cream are invented.
facts.fix: Mr Gruber's hot cocoa with cream
